### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `mpc.c` addresses a logic error that was introduced in a previous commit (4cf1605299c06df111acf15cf2e94eb2d52cc562). 
- By moving the status assignment to an `else` block, the patch ensures that the transmission status is only set to busy when it is appropriate, thereby fixing the issue where the master would not transmit any messages. This change directly resolves the bug that prevented packets from being sent.

        diff --git a/include/mpc.c b/include/mpc.c

 	ATOMIC_BLOCK(ATOMIC_RESTORESTATE) {
 		if ( queue_empty(&tx_state.queue.hdr) || tx_state.status != TX_STATUS_IDLE ) 
 			okay = 0; 
-
-		tx_state.status = TX_STATUS_BUSY;
+		else
